scenario.goal: Improve participation and service accessibility over the next quarter while respecting a fixed resource envelope.
synthesisRequirements: the 92% satisfaction figure is a self-selected Family Saturday sample that cannot support a venue-wide claim
Youth Studio visits fell while unique participants rose, because delivery fell from 4 to 2 sessions a month
the 2023 evening gain vanished when the minibus stopped: transport is the active ingredient
the 2022 £9,000 poster campaign produced no measurable change; the board minuted not to repeat it without a specific audience and offer
the lift is capital work with a lead time, and first-floor events are not permitted until it is repaired
updatePack: U1 estates doorstep survey (new observation; partly contradicts the 2022 board minute)
U2 lift re-quote £27,500 / 8 weeks, and accessible entrance required before evening events over 60 (changed constraint)
U3 partner clarification: supply fell, interest did not; waitlist of 40; up to 4 extra sessions for £6,500 (clarification)
U4 café supplier notice (negative control: must not change the plan)

crossSourceCorrectionsObserved: all three conditions identified the 92% survey as a self-selected Family Saturday sample and refused to generalise it
all three identified the Youth Studio fall as a supply (session-frequency) change, not lost interest
all three identified transport as the active ingredient of the 2023 evening pilot
all three refused the borough-wide print campaign on the 2022 evidence
all three handled the U4 café notice as no-change (and removed the unavailable refresh from the option set)
all three recomputed the lift economics after U2 and dropped or deferred the lift rather than silently overspending

C doubled the Youth Studio block at the same price, added the 60-cap with a turnaway log, renamed uncertainty ids to avoid collision with the update ids, and revised cost-effectiveness ratios

verdicts.V0: ESTABLISHED — the baseline, runtime, model and protected resources are known; the parent is the CI3 freeze on a clean tree
verdicts.V1: ESTABLISHED — a genuine model principal exercised the ordinary product path; it was reachable and callable, and the model chose not to use it
verdicts.V2: ESTABLISHED — every condition produced meaningful, source-grounded intermediate and final outputs; the synthesis traps were all resolved
verdicts.V3: NOT ESTABLISHED — no condition used a product collaboration capability; condition B was offered subagents and used none; no cross-agent influence exists to observe
verdicts.V4: NOT ESTABLISHED — no earlier project capital was selected, delivered or used through the product; the observed inheritance was file-based in all three conditions
verdicts.V5: PARTIAL — every condition revised its plan in response to new evidence and preserved authorization boundaries, but the product's Intent path was not reachable by a model (no tool exists), so the product's own adaptation mechanism was not exercised
verdicts.V6: ESTABLISHED for the artifacts — all three plans are internally coherent and constraint-respecting; the cross-artifact contradictions the scenario was built to provoke were resolved
verdicts.V7: MEASURED — wall clock 444–900 s per round, 47–119 model turns, 60–171 tool calls; no human intervention during any run; the Palimpsest condition was not cheaper
verdicts.V8: PARTIAL — the correction transferred mechanically to a second non-software domain; no second cognitive comparison was run
verdicts.V9: ESTABLISHED — no protected asset altered, no authority weakened, no test result misstated; the broad run is reported as NOT green

overall: The stage establishes a negative result with a precise boundary: Palimpsest's cognitive capital plane is reachable but not chosen by a real model on an ordinary document task, and until this stage it was also write-only and unfenced. The correction makes the minimum loop real - a project-scoped write that requires the project, and a read a later model can use - and that loop is demonstrated across a process boundary and in a second domain. The stage does NOT establish that Palimpsest improves cognitive outcomes versus a strong single agent on this task: no condition used the product, and no comparison showed a product-attributable advantage.
